newsitem.title: UK: LIG firm on double-digit EPS-growth outlook.
newsitem.headline: LIG firm on double-digit EPS-growth outlook.

text.p: Shares in London International Group Plc (LIG) were up 12 pence to 168-1/2p by 1140 GMT in volume of 3.5 million shares, after the condom to rubber glove maker promised "double-digit earnings growth" in the next few years.
"Rising profits. That's exactly what the markets like to hear", a trader said. The firmer share price was in response to stronger-than-forecast full year results, another dealer said.
LIG reported a 12.6 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 29.5 million stg in the year ending on March 31, 1997.
The company's chief executive Nick Hodges said in an interview with Reuters that LIG's three-year restructuring was now over and the company was poised to enter a new stage of growth.
Last week broker Merill Lynch rated LIG a "buy", dealers said.
